The '''''Pradeux''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that was a part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]<ref name="EGTW" /> and measuring 1,600 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="DB" /> it had a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] that was outfitted with<ref name="EGTW" /> a [[Communications tower/Legends|communications tower]]<ref name="CommTower" /> and at least one [[ISD-72x deflector shield generator dome]].<ref name="ShieldDome" />

The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] shared its name with [[Pers Pradeux]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Pius Dea Era]] who at one point reorganized and rebuilt the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. The ''Pradeux'' was commissioned at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the Empire in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], and its commissioning ceremony was carried out inside a [[Cloud/Legends|cloudy]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Multiple [[Flight group/Legends|flights]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] flew past the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and the event was also witnessed by many [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniformed]] Imperial dignitaries standing on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|hovering]] platforms.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Pradeux'' was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. In the book, the starship was illustrated by [[Drew Baker]].<ref name="EGTW" />
